issue.title: Service host graceful stop takes 2-14s; suspect a proc ignores SIGTERM until SIGKILL
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** src/sase/service host stop path (_stop_all_children sequential stop)

Graceful host stops take 2-14s (journal: Stopping sase.service 08:53:14, Stopped/Started 08:53:27 = 13s; 14s on 2026-09-24 18:16). At least one service proc appears to ignore SIGTERM until its 10s stop_timeout_seconds SIGKILL. The Telegram 30s long-poll is a likely suspect.

Repro: systemctl --user restart sase.service after a code update, or time stop_service_host; observe multi-second stop and restart_service_host returning ok=False timed out while systemd finishes on its own.

Impact: lifecycle commands misreport failure; required raising SERVICE_HOST_LIFECYCLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS to 120s. Slow restarts delay post-update recovery.

task_type_fields.impact: Slow post-update restarts; lifecycle commands misreport failure without the 120s budget
task_type_fields.repro: systemctl --user restart sase.service; journal shows 2-14s stops (13s on 2026-09-25 08:53, 14s on 2026-09-24 18:16)
